question: How can verified source-reproduction and exploratory results be displayed with explicit animal units, denominators and source-concordance limits?
decision: Provide six article-style figure plates for reviewing the eight Nb5 branches without converting visual patterns into acceptance.
strongest_rival: Pooled cells, missing design strata, changing denominators or unverified source labels can look convincing when rendered without unit and selection context.
discriminator: Display individual mice, source versus released counts, cell-weighted and mouse-weighted summaries, distinct RNA endpoints, fixed markers and documented repertoire denominators.
exposure_record: All descriptive_v1, repertoire_v2 and source_audit_v1 outputs have been inspected. Figures are outcome-exposed documentation of fixed descriptive results, not a new validation study.
biological_unit: Deposited mouse within each assay and tissue; slash-containing lung IDs are explicitly pooled libraries, excluded from mouse-weighted expression contrasts and composition accounting.
nesting_and_overlap: Repeated tissue and assay samples and the general versus Figure 4 brain objects reuse mice/cells. IDs use different source formats. No cross-organ independence, canonical cross-assay identity resolution or external replication is asserted.
population_and_selection: Verified frozen analysis output tables only. Display fixed marker subset and predeclared organ/cell-type panels; full families remain available in tables.
contrast: Visualize the previously executed contrasts, without refitting biological models or calculating significance.
endpoint: Six figure plates and a combined PDF with animal points, source context and exact measurement labels.
methods: Matplotlib white backgrounds, labeled panels, consistent ages, explicit units, 300-dpi PNG and SVG/PDF vector text. Means are arithmetic mouse means, not cell-based uncertainty. Age panels use categorical spacing and retain one month as developmental context. Source microglial number sets are displayed as a concordance audit because final-paper mapping is unresolved. Repertoire uses v2 matched denominators and within-mouse clone groups. No additional hypothesis tests.
missingness_and_exclusions: Missing contrasts remain absent; pooled lung labels omitted from individual-mouse coverage and weighted analyses. All exclusions inherit the frozen source analysis. Source-state annotation subset is stated in captions.
multiplicity: No p-values, significance stars, rankings by effect or confirmatory claims. The fixed descriptive marker family and all contrasts are retained, including null/unfavorable values.
precision_basis: Show every observed mouse and descriptive means; no biological-effect margin, independent unit variance justification or confirmatory power is available.
interpretation_limit: Normalized RNA detection is not senescence, secretion, pathway activation or repair. Source UMAP, cluster occupancy and signature overlap cannot establish trajectory, a distinct intermediate state or AD treatment direction. Clonality is conditional on reconstruction and tissue sampling, not immune performance. Broad shared-age signatures have prior art. No claim promotion.
stop_rule: Stop on missing source tables or rendering failure. Inspect every PNG; layout corrections require a new version while retaining this output.
amendment_reason: Initial research-article visual rendering of verified numerical outputs; figure settings are frozen before rendering.
